product_metadata.title: KEFF Shredded Memory Foam Pillows for Sleeping - Cooling Bamboo Pillow with Premium Adjustable Loft Bed Pillows - Washable Removable Derived Rayon Cover (Queen Size 1 Pack)
features: DOUBLE PACK OFFER: If you are thinking to buy 2 pillows, prefer double pack. So you will save 1 usd in total.

KEFF HOME MEMORY FOAM PILLOW ELIMINATES PRESSURE POINTS - largely considered to be the most versatile and comfortable pillows for sleeping you can buy. It's filled with shredded memory foam that gently cradles your head and neck, relieving pressure that often leads to aches and pains. The shape of the contour pillow fills in the gap between your neck and the mattress, keeping your spine in proper alignment while you snooze.

BEST SPINAL ALIGNMENT - Our luxury cervical firm pillow gives greater resistance under the heaviest parts of the head and equally supports the lighter more pressure sensitive neck area. KEFF HOME memory foam pillow helps reduce tossing turning and discomfort. It allows your muscles to relax properly offering natural spinal support to your body adjusting to your unique shape promoting a deep restful sleep.

HELPS WITH GOOD SLEEP - it is commonly believed that the spinal alignment also aligns the airways better allowing easier breathing at night. The lack of pressure points during sleeping with KEFF HOME cervical pillow may also be a benefit to those with sleeping problems as there is less tossing and turning. This leads to sound restful sleep.

EXTRA DURABLE AND AESTHETIC PILLOW - Memory Foam Pillow retains its shape so it will not go flat like traditional pillows. KEFF HOME special foam conforms to fit the neck and head but as it is cooling it reverts to its original shape. Memory foam returns to its shape reliably again and again. It will outlast other high quality pillows simply by design.
description: BAMBOO FABRIC. The special design woven bamboo cover provides a sound sleep because it is cool.
SOFT. The memory foams are 100% new production.
USEFUL. KEFF bamboo fabric special woven pillow is prepared to carry with you, whether you are in the bedroom or traveling.
ADJUSTABLE. Excess memory foams can be removed.
DURABLE. It has a special woven sturdy pillow lining and very sturdy inner and outer zips.
MEMORY FOAM FEATURE. The memory foam in the product takes the appropriate position for your neck health according to your lying position.

EASY TO CLEAN. The pillowcase and pillow lining are easily cleaned. Product UsageThe pillow case that you removed from the box, whether by hand or dryer, place the pillowcase with the foams which is inside and let it run at low speed to swell memory foam. Keep excess foams in the foam bag that comes out of the box.

Product CleaningWith a special woven bamboo pillow case, the pillow lining opens easily from its sturdy zippers. It is then washed easily in the washing machine. In the preparation for washing, the memory foams in the pillow case should be placed in the foam bag.After the cushion lining has dried, the desired amount of foams is placed in the lining and the zipper is closed and the zipper is pulled by passing it to pillowcase.
